description_detailed: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of the cinema release of the first chapter of Peter Jackson's trilogy, Monnaie de Paris will unveil a collection of precious coins dedicated to the legendary Lord of the Rings series in 2026. From the Shire to Mordor, the perilous journey of the Fellowship of the Ring is now engraved in metal, celebrating a mythical saga that has become a true pillar of the fantasy genre.A symbol of protection and friendship, the leaf of Lórien is given by the Elves of the Golden Forest to the Fellowship of the Ring during their visit to Lothlórien. Its delicate and natural appearance makes it an instantly recognisable emblem of Elven culture.The perfect gift for fans of The Lord of the Rings saga, this pure gold collector's coin will increase in value over time and will always be worth at least its face value.
